verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's docs confirm event-driven mechanisms—webhooks for triggering on subscription/campaign events (mailchimp-docs-19, mailchimp-docs-18) and event-driven transactional messaging (mailchimp-docs-2)—and mention 'automations' as an existing feature in the AI insights context (mailchimp-docs-25), but there is no detailed documentation of a dedicated rule-builder/automation engine (e.g., Customer Journeys) in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual/API automation-rules builder, examples of conditional trigger-action workflows, and independent corroboration that automations work reliably.
